title: House of the Dragon Star Matthew Needham to Voice Joker in Batman: Caped Crusader Season 2
excerpt: The actor behind Larys Strong brings a 'European and humorless' take on the Clown Prince of Crime, while Wunmi Mosaku joins as a reimagined Roxy Rocket. All 10 episodes premiere July 31 on Prime Video.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Matthew Needham voices a stoic, humorless Joker in Batman: Caped Crusader Season 2.
  • Wunmi Mosaku's Roxy Rocket is reimagined as a steampunk character with a tragic backstory.
  • Season 2 features the Riddler, Scarecrow, Mad Hatter, and Poison Ivy as villains.
  • All 10 episodes premiere on July 31 on Prime Video and Amazon Luna.
A New Take on Iconic Characters
›Matthew Needham as Joker: European and humorless interpretation.
›Wunmi Mosaku as Roxy Rocket: Steampunk, revenge-driven character.
›Villains include: Riddler, Scarecrow, Mad Hatter, Poison Ivy.
›All episodes available on July 31, 2024.

Matthew Needham, best known for his role as Lord Larys Strong in HBO’s House of the Dragon, has been cast as the Joker in Batman: Caped Crusader Season 2. Prime Video announced the casting during a panel at San Diego Comic-Con on Thursday, where the creative team also screened the season premiere episode for the first time.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=pNhijtUqyeg

Needham attended the panel alongside executive producers James Tucker and Geoffrey Thorne, and fellow voice cast members Hamish Linklater, who voices Batman, and Jamie Chung, who plays Harley Quinn. He confirmed his involvement in the upcoming season and in the companion video game Batman: Caped Crusader – Chronicles, launching the same day on Amazon Luna.

A Joker Unlike Any Before

This version of the Clown Prince of Crime departs sharply from the manic energy audiences associate with previous portrayals. Speaking to CBR at Comic-Con, Needham revealed the audition brief was just two words: “European and humorless.”

https://x.com/DiscussingFilm/status/2080436236838187333

“I was just going off what the writers were giving me, and there was an amazing gift in that. If somebody asked me to just try and copy Mark Hamill, what’s the point? Nobody can do it. But this was such a departure, such a new spin on it, that I felt a bit more comfortable giving it a go.”

— Matthew Needham, actor

Co-showrunner James Tucker told Entertainment Weekly the character draws from Conrad Veidt’s silent film performances and German expressionism. “That led us to reinterpret Joker as a character who basically came from silent movies,” Tucker said. “And that informed his stoicism and his coldness, because he’s kind of a cold character in this interpretation.”

Tucker also offered a broader perspective on what comics-savvy viewers might recognise. “For people who’ve read comics for a long, long time, it won’t be [different]. I think some people will recognize it and go, ‘Oh, I see what they’re doing,’” he told The Direct.

Wunmi Mosaku and a Rogues’ Gallery Overhaul

The Joker is far from the only addition. British-Nigerian actress Wunmi Mosaku, an Oscar nominee for Sinners and known for her roles in Loki and Lovecraft Country, voices Roxy Rocket — a character Tucker described as “radically different” from her 1990s animated series debut.

Rather than a daredevil stuntwoman, this Roxy Rocket is a steampunk figure driven by revenge, with visual cues drawn from Jack Parsons’ rocket engineering, Commando Cody, and The Rocketeer. “We gave her a tragic backstory. In the context of the show, it’s a revenge story, but we don’t know that necessarily at first. We don’t even know she’s a she at first,” Tucker told Entertainment Weekly.

Global Ambitions of Batman: Caped Crusader
›Available in over 240 countries and territories.
›Features British and international voice talent.
›Strong fanbase in India reflects global reach.

Season 2’s villain roster also features the Riddler as its primary antagonist, along with Scarecrow, a gender-swapped Mad Hatter (renamed Hattie Tetch, voiced by Laraine Newman), and Poison Ivy. The returning cast includes Krystal Joy Brown as Barbara Gordon, Eric Morgan Stuart, Grey DeLisle, John DiMaggio, and Tom Kenny.

The Indian Audience Connection

Batman commands a devoted fanbase across India, and the animated series’ growing roster of British and international talent — Needham is British, Mosaku is British-Nigerian — reflects the franchise’s global ambitions. Season 2 will be available in over 240 countries and territories simultaneously.

What’s Next

Batman: Caped Crusader is executive produced by Bruce Timm, J.J. Abrams, Matt Reeves, Ed Brubaker, and Sam Register. Warner Bros. Animation produces in partnership with DC Studios, Bad Robot Productions, and 6th & Idaho.

All 10 episodes of Season 2 drop on Prime Video on July 31, the same date as the Chronicles game on Amazon Luna. The show has already been renewed: Season 1 earned strong reviews after its debut in August 2024, with Timm’s noir-drenched Gotham drawing comparisons to the original Batman: The Animated Series.
nri_angle: Batman's massive Indian fanbase gets a globally accessible Season 2 on Prime Video across 240+ countries, with British and international voice talent reflecting the franchise's broadening reach.
